note: Shared by plugins/arc-hooks/scripts/lib.test.js and extension/src/transcript.test.ts. The snapshot hook and the turn timeline must agree on which files are the agent's own scratch, or a turn's file list and its pending diffs disagree. The runners set the vendor variables to absolute paths with dot segments, then expand {claudeHome} and {codexHome} to their normalized forms. Other templates are {tmp} for os.tmpdir(), {home} for os.homedir(), and {arcHome} for ARC_HOME or {home}/.arc.

shapesNote: Every case is run in each of these path shapes, and must give the same answer in all of them. One side normalising a shape that the other compares raw is exactly how the two rules drift apart, and a fixture that only ever tests the native shape cannot see it. The trailing-slash shape is skipped for a case that names a file, because a file path does not take one; keep at least one directory case on each side of the answer so that shape still tests both.
